# EmailCheck

EmailCheck is an email verification API. It checks an email address at domain level:
syntax, domain existence, MX routing, disposable-domain and role-account signals,
likely typos with a correction suggestion (e.g. gmial.com -> gmail.com), domain age
in days from RDAP registration records (null when no record exists, never estimated),
and a catch-all risk signal (low / possible / unknown) inferred from MX and provider
patterns and labelled as a signal, not a probed conclusion.

Every result carries a 0-100 score and a verdict: valid (score 80 or above with MX
present), risky (50-79, or a likely typo), invalid. Every response carries
scope: "domain-level" and a note stating exactly what was checked.

What EmailCheck does NOT do: it does not probe whether an individual mailbox exists
(no SMTP probing), and a valid result does not confirm a mailbox exists.

## API

Base URL: https://emailcheck-api.pages.dev

- GET /validate?email=... — validate one address
- POST /validate — same check, JSON body {"email": "..."}
- POST /validate/batch — JSON body {"emails": ["...", ...]}, up to 100 addresses;
  per-address results in submission order plus a summary
  {total, valid, risky, invalid, disposable, typoLikely} with counts and percentages.
  Batch errors are named JSON: MISSING_EMAIL, EMPTY_BATCH, BATCH_TOO_LARGE, INVALID_JSON.
  A bad entry marks only itself invalid; it never fails the batch.

## Pricing (subscriptions run on the marketplaces)

RapidAPI (https://rapidapi.com/binbin7418/api/emailcheck-email-validation-api):
- BASIC: free, 100 calls per month
- PRO: $9/month, 10,000 calls per month
- ULTRA: $29/month, 50,000 calls per month

api.market: Free Trial 7 days with 100 calls; Pro $9/month; Ultra $29/month;
overage $0.002 per extra request.

Checkout totals are shown by the platform for the buyer's region and may include
local taxes. A Zyla listing ("Email List Validation API") has been submitted and
is under review.
